# PR #5087: Patch: a job ran over 10 minutes

Closes #5046

The flagged job, `rust (test tools, wasm 4/4)`, no longer exists on `main`, so I changed no count. I added 8 comment lines to `scripts/ci-shards.toml` above `"tools, wasm" = 8`. They record why, so the next "job ran over 10 minutes" issue for this group starts from the next step to try.

## What the issue's run was

- **Old config:** the issue's run (`d9fb4d6`, 08:05 UTC) used the old `"tools, wasm" = 4`. #4739 (`7fb76d5cb4`, 08:11 UTC) raised it to 8 six minutes later. That was the fix for #4721. On this branch `python3 .github/ci/matrix.py matrix` lists `tools, wasm 1/8` … `8/8` and no `4/4`.
- **Why 1/4 and 4/4 were slow:** I checked with `zlib.crc32(name) % total + 1`, the formula `matrix.py shard` uses.
  - At 4 shards the three slowest `fork_screen` R4607000 tests land in shards 1, 4 and 1, so two shared shard 1.
  - At 8 shards they land in 5, 8 and 1, so no two share a shard.
- **Next step:** the count is at its cap of 8 (`MAX_SHARDS`). The comment says that if a `tools, wasm k/8` shard still passes 8 minutes on a base that holds #4739, split the group's tests across more binaries or daily-move the slowest. A cheaper per-PR test would keep each rule.

## Not measured

I had no timing of the 8-shard config, so I cannot say `tools, wasm k/8` finishes under 8 minutes. The evidence is #4721's estimate and the hash spread above, nothing from a run. The comment only records that the old job is gone and the count is at its cap. If `ci-duration.yml` reports a `tools, wasm k/8` shard over 8 minutes on a branch that holds #4739, that needs a person or a larger item. More test binaries means changing `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`, which the bot cannot touch.

## Tests

- `git diff --stat`: only `scripts/ci-shards.toml`, 8 insertions, 0 deletions. No key or value changed.
- `python3 -m unittest bot.tests.test_ci_matrix`: 15 tests, OK.
- `cd bot && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`: 87 tests, OK.
- `python3 .github/ci/matrix.py matrix`: the file parses, and the last stderr line is `web (unit k/8), e2e smoke (k/4), rust (fuzz slice k/4)`.
- `cargo jackioh patches check`: passes. A comment is no catalog change.
- I did not run the rest of the harness's checks. No code, spec or generated file changed, and none of them read a comment in this file.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Which PR the comment cites.** The plan said #4739 and the file's older comment says #4721. #4739 is the PR (commit `7fb76d5cb4`) and #4721 the issue it fixed, so the comment says "#4739 (#4721's fix, the count of 8)".
- **Wording about `#[ignore]`.** I wrote "daily-move the slowest" instead of a literal `#[ignore = "daily: …"]`, which the older comment in this block already uses, so no scan of ignore attributes can match a TOML comment.
- **Closing with no PR.** The plan raised this: the fix already landed in #4739 and the comment adds no behaviour. I built the comment as planned. A person who prefers to close the issue can discard this PR.

I did not touch `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py` or anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/`.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-4`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 4.9 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 6s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 3s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 197s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | timed out: inconclusive, left to CI | 1800s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 225s |

</details>
